title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Strengthens Its Commitment to League Bowling
summary: Company enhances the league experience while welcoming new and longtime bowlers nationwide Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK), one of the world's premier owner-operators of location-based entertainment, is expanding its investment in league bowling with enhancements designed to strengthen the league experience for longtime bowlers while introducing more guests to the sport through League Open Houses taking place this week at 244 participating centers nationwide. As part of the company's continued commitment to league bowling, Lucky Strike Entertainment is investing in upgrades to lane conditioning and oil patterns across 270 centers, providing league bowlers with more consistent playing conditions and an enhanced experience on the lanes. More than 300,000 bowlers currently participate in leagues across the company's portfolio, reflecting the important role leagues continue to play across its nationwide network of centers.
